what: Envato's help center positions its project-based licensing as different from licensing models that restrict usage by location or platform.
verbatim_snippet: "Unlike licensing models that restrict usage by location or platform, Envato subscription uses project-based licensing. Each license covers one complete project, regardless of where or how that project is shared or distributed."
